scope: Owner-approved R16 live check of the web control page against the real machine: the page ran on the SAS host bound to loopback and tools/web_control_live_check.py drove it over HTTP. Each run plays one remote spin at the page's chosen bet and then adds 10 credits by AFT in-house transfer through the page. No settings, profile, outcome or cash-out actions.
evidence_kind: The live check's own stdout records (allowlisted semantic fields only) and the pre-credit step's record. No URL, raw HTTP, serial bytes, host, user, device or path.

runs.name: pre-credit
runs.why: The machine read 0 credits, so with the owner's approval the page first added 10 credits through its own Add credits, verified from /state.json.

runs.name: run 1
runs.why: Spin verified. The top-up was refused at the page's admission with nothing sent: right after a game the machine briefly stops offering transfers to the machine (AFT available-transfers), and this version of the check posted the top-up at once.

runs.name: run 2
runs.why: With the owner's approval, the check (now waiting, reading only, until the page admits the top-up) ran once more and passed every step.
